description: Remote lookup field. Pulls values from a DATASET (a list flow), as opposed to a Lookup which pulls from a Process. Captured as Type:"Reference" with a Field::QueryDefinition whose FlowType is "Dataset" — the ONLY difference from a Lookup (field_lookup.json, FlowType "Process"). Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #46); ids de-identified.
notes: Same Type:"Reference" + Field::QueryDefinition family as Lookup and User — the three differ only in QueryDefinition.FlowType (Dataset / Process / User).
LHSModel = the referenced dataset (list flow) id; FlowType "Dataset". The list flow must exist first.
Per-field lookup routes are a known 500 dead-end at runtime (CLAUDE.md) — do not probe.
